title: Romance Scam
summary: A romance scam is when a fraudster builds an online relationship to eventually ask for money, gifts or investments. Requests for money from someone you've never met in person are a major warning sign.
answer_guidance: Keep it light, practical and encouraging. Define slang plainly and give realistic tips; avoid gender stereotypes.
